Dhanbad ke sansad dhulu mahto ke ghar beti ki shadi ko lekar bhavy taiyariyan ki ja rahi hain. is khas aayojan men kaee VVIP aur VIP mehmanon ke shamil hone ki sanbhavna hai. shadi samaroh ko lekar taiyariyan tej hain aur rajnitik va samajik jagat ki kaee charchit hastiyon ke pahunchne ki charcha hai.
